original.statement: The upgrade guide describes a migration path for 3.0: disable structured metadata (allow_structured_metadata: false in limits_config, or -validation.allow-structured-metadata=false), upgrade to 3.0, then perform the schema migration.

decision.reason: [ev-649f409b4be1] describes an operator step: disable Structured Metadata (allow_structured_metadata: false in limits_config, or -validation.allow-structured-metadata=false), upgrade to 3.0, and only then do the schema migration. That fits the migration family with migration-required. [ev-8b7267b73a1c] explains why the step exists: Structured Metadata is on by default in 3.0 and needs a tsdb index with the v13 schema. It gives no literal earlier default, so the evidence can't support recasting this as a config-key default-changed. One caveat: [ev-7791a108cc39] gives upgrading the schema first as the other option, so this step is one of two ways through, not the only one. Which environments it applies to is a separate aspect and isn't being checked here.
